FIELD GUIDE / 01

Follow the evidence.

Signal Desk is a working investigation demo built around a fictional city exercise.

  1. Find a thread

    Search words such as “substation”, filter by source or severity, or open an incident channel.

  2. Watch it develop

    Replay reports in chronological order. Pause, scrub the progress slider, or select a chart bar to focus on a time window.

  3. Build a case

    Open a report, save it as evidence and add your observation. Saved reports and notes remain in this workspace.

  4. Take it with you

    Export a Markdown brief of your saved evidence, or the current filtered view if nothing is saved.

Use your own dataset

Import a JSON object containing a name and reports array (up to 2 MB / 5,000 reports). Required report fields: id, timestamp, title, body, topic, incident, category, location, source, severity, status. Severity is low, medium or high. Dates must include a timezone. IDs must be unique. Use the example dataset as a template.

The hosted demo stores your evidence and imports in this browser. This is not a monitored emergency service. Source labels are part of the fictional scenario, not independently verified facts.
